title: Capture a command's output
summary: dup2 the pipe onto the child's stdout; the parent reads what the command prints.
hints: In the child: `close(p[0]); dup2(p[1], STDOUT_FILENO); close(p[1]); execvp(argv[1], &argv[1]);`.
The parent closes `p[1]`, reads the pipe through `fdopen(p[0], "r")` and `fgets`, and prints each line after the two characters `> `.
